title: Ordinary SQLite storage: clarify mandatory empty metadata initialization
outcome: Correct the storage documentation's obsolete empty-store metadata exception for primary format 4
acceptance: The SQLite session storage guide states that current-format databases initialize and require complete metadata units even when empty, and limits the absent-units exception to supported migration from a proven uninitialized predecessor. The explanation agrees with the storage initializer and reader contract.
The candidate changes only the SQLite session storage guide and passes the repository Markdown link check on its exact clean committed input.
